lobby.simpleDesc: Keeps only moving, looking, firing, aiming, reloading, jumping, crouching, sprinting, switching weapons, grenades and vehicles. No class gadgets, medkits, melee, building, call-ins or revives; reserve ammo never runs out.
lobby.allUnlockedDesc: In this room everyone may pick any weapon, whatever their level. XP and weapon levels still rise.
mapDesc.iron_gate: A tight old town: the townhall square on its rise in the middle, the factories and the iron gate checkpoint either side, the hospital north and the gas station south. A canal cuts through the town.
mapDesc.ardennes: A valley town between a snowy mountainside and a wide river: the sawmill on the slope, the fishing hamlet on the point, the hotel square and the church on the upper terrace, the station and the rail yard by the quay.
mapDesc.lyon: A hilltop village of stone houses in terraces, ringed by lavender fields: the church on top, the upper square, the market, the watermill by the stream and the farm.
mapDesc.bilbao: A riverside city under siege: hold the attack from the east at the warehouse yard, the tank square and the cathedral. Made for Conquest.
mapDesc.persia: A small desert village across a wadi: the round square and its market, the oasis bridge and the fort, fought up close. For 4v4, light vehicles only.
mapDesc.ashfall: A volcanic island with a black-sand beach. The attackers come from a transport offshore in landing craft, over the pillbox line, through the village and the jungle, across the airfield to the cave HQ at the volcano's foot. For 64v64.
mapDesc.coral_reach: A Midway-style carrier battle on a 6 x 5 km sea: man the stations of a carrier, battleship, destroyer and submarine. Fleet battle only.
mapDesc.sandbox: A practice range with every weapon and targets.
modeDesc.zone: Every zone you hold scores a point every 5 s. First side to the target wins.
modeDesc.fleet: Each side's four warships are its only spawn points. A sunk ship is gone for good. Sink the whole enemy fleet to win; after 30 minutes the side with more fleet health left wins.
modeDesc.frontline: A front pushed one sector at a time. Losing a sector makes you the attacker; run out of attack time and the roles swap.
modeDesc.conquest: The defenders start with every zone; the attackers break through one sector at a time. Only the attackers have tickets.
modeDesc.hardpoint: One live point that moves every 60 s. Have more soldiers in it than the enemy and score a point a second (level: nobody). First to 200, or ahead after 10 minutes.
modeDesc.tdm: A point for every enemy downed. First to the target (team size × 7), or ahead after 10 minutes. Zones are spawn points only.
modeDesc.killconfirm: Downed enemies drop tags: pick them up to score. Pick up your own side's to deny the enemy.
modeDesc.ffa: Everyone is an enemy. First to 20 kills, or the most kills after 10 minutes, wins. A down is a death; you are back 2 s later away from everyone.
modeDesc.gungame: Every soldier for themselves. Each kill swaps you to the next gun (23 of them, then the rifle butt). Killed by a butt: down a step. A kill on the last step, or the furthest along after 15 minutes, wins.
charge.theyArmed: The enemy armed charge {id} — defuse it
charge.name: Charge
modeDesc.rush: Attackers plant two charges a sector (hold E) and set them off; defenders defuse them. Both gone: on to the next sector. Only the attackers have tickets.
modeDesc.snd: One life a round, no reviving. Attackers plant at one of two sites; defenders stop them or defuse. Sides swap after 3 rounds; first to 4 wins.
escort.delivered: The payload has reached its goal
modeDesc.escort: Attackers move an APC along the zones (checkpoints) by outnumbering the defenders within 10 m of it. Each checkpoint adds time; the last one wins it for the attackers, running out of time for the defenders.
modeDesc.fortress: The first 90 s are a build phase (a truce, building 3x as fast): each side fortifies its own zones. Then zone domination decides it.
lms.shrink: The circle is closing — get inside the white fence
modeDesc.lastman: Every soldier for themselves, one life. Start with a pistol and find guns in crates (walk up to open). The circle closes by stages and hurts outside it. The last one alive wins.
modeTag.frontline: one sector at a time, back and forth
modeTag.killconfirm: pick up the tags to score
modeTag.lastman: a closing circle, the last one up

tut.title: Tutorial

tut.look: Move the mouse to look around.
tut.lookTouch: Drag on the right side to look around.
tut.sprint: Hold it while moving forward to sprint.
tut.sprintTouch: Push the stick all the way to sprint.
tut.crouch: Crouch (toggle). Press it while sprinting to slide.
tut.crouchTouch: Crouch button. Press it while sprinting to slide.
tut.aim: Hold to aim down the sights for accurate shots.
tut.grenadeTouch: Tap the grenade button to throw (hold: change type).
tut.capture: Stand inside a zone to capture it; more teammates capture faster. Find the zones on the top bar and the minimap.
tut.interact: Hold it next to a downed teammate to revive, press it next to a vehicle to get in.
tut.interactTouch: Press the middle button next to a downed teammate or a vehicle.
tut.build: Build mode: hold fire on a marked spot at a zone to build cover.
tut.buildTouch: Build button: hold fire on a marked spot at a zone to build cover.

setDesc.crouchHold: Toggle: press once to crouch, again to stand. Hold: crouch only while the key is down (sliding from a sprint still works). Keyboard only; the touch crouch button always toggles.

lobby.sideDesc: Pick which side you fight for. Random is settled when the match starts.
setDesc.menuScene: Plays a recorded film of bot battles behind the main menu (light, nothing to load). Off: the map picture instead.
tip.revive: Hold {k:interact} next to a downed teammate to get them back up.
tip.build: Press {k:build} for build mode, aim at a blue blueprint and hold {k:fire} to put up sandbags.
tip.support: Press {k:support} to spend squad points on smoke, mortars or artillery.
tip.breath: Through a sniper scope, hold {k:breath} to hold your breath and steady the aim. Hold it too long and your sight goes dark.
tip.downed: When you go down, teammates have 15 seconds to revive you. Hold {k:jump} if you would rather not wait.
tip.station: Supply stations at zones your side holds refill ammo and medkits.
tip.rocket: One panzerfaust round brings a sandbag wall down.
tip.squad: On the deploy screen you can spawn next to a squad mate who is not in a fight.
tip.mines: Mines do not go off under someone walking crouched.

acct.guestNote: Signing in lets you play multiplayer and keeps your progress in an account on any device. This browser's progress moves into the account on your first sign-in (up to level 130). Only the provider's account number is used, stored as a hash under the server's key; no email, name or picture is taken.

acct.deleteAsk: This deletes your account and its progress (level, record, history) for good. It cannot be undone. Delete?

acct.savedOnServer: Progress is saved in your account (on the game server).
acct.needLoginWhy: Your name tag and progress belong to your account, so nobody can pass for you, and they follow you to any device. Bot matches and the range need no sign-in.
